arguments.sql:
SELECT 'watermark' AS field, c.watermark AS stored_value, COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE LOWER(c.watermark) IN (
    'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
    'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
)
GROUP BY c.watermark
UNION ALL
SELECT 'language', f.language, COUNT(*)
FROM foreign_data AS f
GROUP BY f.language
ORDER BY field, stored_value

arguments.sql:
WITH guild_counts AS (
    SELECT c.watermark AS guild, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.watermark IN (
        'azorius', 'boros', 'dimir', 'golgari', 'gruul',
        'izzet', 'orzhov', 'rakdos', 'selesnya', 'simic'
    )
      AND c.uuid IN (
          SELECT f.uuid
          FROM foreign_data AS f
          WHERE f.language <> 'English'
      )
    GROUP BY c.watermark
)
SELECT gc.guild, gc.card_count
FROM guild_counts AS gc
WHERE gc.card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM guild_counts)
ORDER BY gc.guild
